description: LONE-FLIP (critic round 4). Saved position from critic game s7454 (Custodes mirror): round 3, Player 2 Movement. P1 holds the centre objective with OC 8; P2 already has OC 5 in range of it, and Custodian Guard Sodality Beta, part of that 5, holds. The AI subtracted Beta's whole OC from the centre's need a second time, read the centre as 'already taken by Beta', and sent Custodian Guard Sodality Gamma (3 models) alone to flip obj_nml_1, which the enemy holds with OC 14 ('needs 6 more OC after this unit'): it cannot flip it and will probably die (rollout value check: Gamma Advancing to the centre instead was +21.5 VP [16.9, 26.1] over 36 seeds). With the fix a unit that holds adds no OC the count did not already include, so the centre still needs 4 OC: the plan sends Custodian Guard Sodality Alpha to flip it with a Normal move, Beta keeps holding, and Gamma goes to obj_home_2 instead of the lone flip (not the measured alternative itself, which was Gamma Advancing to the centre). The scenario opens Suggest (K) twice on the same position: first with FIX_LONE_FLIP=0 (the reviewed plan: Gamma to obj_nml_1, the centre 'already taken'), then with the fix on. Nothing is executed.

steps.comment: BEFORE: switch the fix off for P2 (the player deciding this movement phase)

steps.script: return tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Custodian Guard Sodality Gamma moves toward obj_nml_1")
steps.comment: fix off: the card's headline is the reviewed move

steps.script: return tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Custodian Guard Sodality Gamma [movement]: chose Move obj_nml_1 (flipping it (enemy holds with OC 14)")
steps.comment: fix off: the reviewed mistake is reproduced (Gamma sent alone to flip an OC 14 objective)
fix off: the centre reads as already taken by Beta

steps.script: return tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("obj_center is already taken by Custodian Guard Sodality Beta —")
steps.comment: fix on: the centre is no longer read as 'already taken' by Beta alone (Beta's in-range OC is not subtracted twice)

MERGE: the card is still Gamma's decision. Gamma's objective is no longer pinned: with main's terrain-aware gap obj_nml_1's area is 4.1" from Gamma (one Normal move, not the 2-turn race the lab measured from the centroid), so the plan now prefers it over obj_home_2 — a lone 1-move flip the race guards (RACE-1/FAR-TRIP/LONE-TRIP, 2+ turn trips) do not cover; flagged as a follow-up

steps.script: return tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Custodian Guard Sodality Alpha (OC3): MOVE obj_center")
steps.comment: fix on: the centre still needs OC, so Alpha goes to flip it (Normal move)
